verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents support for over 400 TLDs on a dedicated top-level-domains page, which covers the 'hundreds of extensions' part, and community users confirm .app support. Nothing in the evidence shows per-TLD documentation of special requirements such as restricted TLDs or country-code rules. Community reports also cite gaps in coverage: no .us at one point, and no IDN domains. missing for 10: per-TLD documentation of special or restricted requirements, evidence of country-code TLD requirement handling, coverage of noted gaps like .us and IDN domains, independent corroboration of current TLD breadth

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD

citations.quote: Cloudflare supports over 400 top-level domains (TLDs) and is always evaluating adding new TLDs.
.app Support too! Made the switch already, fast and cheaper than what I was paying at Google.
